[[File:Rowan_Delk.png|thumb|right|150px|Rowan Delk, a victim of Sand Rot]]
'''Sand Rot''' was a curable [[Disease/Legends|disease]] that was contracted from too much [[Desert/Legends|desert]] exposure. As a result, Sand Rot was common on [[Planet/Legends|planets]] such as [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. In [[3643 BBY]], [[Rowan Delk]] received the Sand Rot after being in Tatooine's vast deserts for a long period of [[Time/Legends|time]]. Victims of the disease would often have symptoms of coughing, weakness, and a loss of feeling in their [[Limb/Legends|hands]] and fingers. Though it was treatable, the most widely preferred option was simply taking the patient offworld.
